newsitem.title: UK: UK's Standard Life introduces deposit account.
newsitem.headline: UK's Standard Life introduces deposit account.

text.p: Mutual life assurance company Standard Life said it would introduce a deposit account from October 28.
The company said in a statement underlying banking would be carried out by the Bank of Scotland.
Rates of interest on the account will range from 4.5 percent gross for 1,000 stg to 5.4 percent gross for 50,000 stg and over.
It said the account would also have the option of a Bank of Scotland ATM card.
The account will initially be targeted at customers with maturing endowment policies and will be available only to Standard Life customers.
"We can offer interest rates which are significantly better than those available from high street brances of banks and building societies," said Standard Life marketing spokesman Peter Robertson.
But he said the move "does not indicate an attempt to compete head on with banks and building societies in their own markets."
